confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and Cebu context; no live booking pages, menus or current listings were inspected. Food and beer anchors are the most reliable; hostel and hotel anchors vary widely by district (IT Park and Ayala versus Mactan resort areas). Cocktail and wine_glass are set at roughly three times the beer anchor because direct knowledge of Cebu bar and by-the-glass wine prices is weaker. Remembered peso prices were brought forward to July 2026 without a live exchange-rate check; no seasonal adjustment was made for July's wet season, which mainly affects beach-resort rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: general knowledge of Cebu City and Mactan pricing, positioned as a mid-sized Philippine tourism center that sits below Metro Manila for hotels and alongside other Visayas and Mindanao tourism cities such as Iloilo and Davao; dining positioned against mid-sized Southeast Asian tourist cities.
